name: manipulate_recursive
description: One link of a chained transformation: reads the PREVIOUS step's output, never the run's original input

meta.why_not_manipulate: manipulate reads {{INPUT_TEXT}}, which chunk_builder fills with the text Stage 1 checked -- the same text on every pass. A chain needs the link before it, so this template reads {{PREVIOUS_OUTPUT}} (which falls back to the run input on the first pass) and names the language the step is going into. The safety prefix still rides on {{TASK_INSTRUCTION}}.
